primary_source.citation: Wyser, K. (1998), The Effective Radius in Ice Clouds, Journal of Climate 11(7), 1793–1802, DOI 10.1175/1520-0442(1998)011<1793:TERIIC>2.0.CO;2.

integration_bounds_um.qualification: Section 5 says these are the integration limits for all calculations in the paper unless otherwise stated. Section 6 gives no alternate limits for the Eq. (20) values used to fit Eq. (35); applying the stated default to the Eq. (35) derivation is therefore supported by the paper, with that cross-section inference kept explicit.

distribution.equation: Section 6 states n(L) is calculated according to Eq. (15), then Eq. (20) is evaluated.
distribution.kind: mixed small-particle gamma plus large-particle power law
distribution.small_size_component: n(L)=A_M L^nu exp(-lambda L), L <= 20 um; nu=3 and lambda=0.3 um^-1.
distribution.large_size_component: n(L)=alpha A_M L^B, L > 20 um; alpha is selected to make n(L) continuous at 20 um.
distribution.B_inputs: B is Eq. (14), a function of temperature and IWC; the article says the mixed distribution Eq. (15) is evaluated across B=-6..-2 for the fit.
distribution.parameter_note: The article also notes that the small-particle distribution is assumed independent of T and IWC; changing that component changes re and requires refitting even when B is unchanged.

recipe.geometry_context: The article assumes hexagonal columns with size-dependent aspect ratio (abstract and Section 2).

primary_text_evidence.finding: All calculations use Lmin=10 um and Lmax=1000 um unless stated otherwise.
Mixed gamma/power-law spectrum; join at 20 um; nu=3, lambda=0.3 um^-1; alpha gives continuity; B depends on T and IWC.
For Eq. (35), calculate n(L) using Eq. (15) over B from -6 to -2; calculate re using Eq. (20); fit a third-order polynomial in B.

coefficient_authority: Implemented UDM coefficients are authenticated from pinned production source. Literal numerical Eq35 coefficients have not been recovered from the retained primary equation resource; do not call that a primary coefficient verification.

same_population_geometry.aspect_ratio: x=L/D=1 for L<=30 um; x=1+0.003*(L-30) otherwise

scope: Recovered paper recipe only; pinned RRTMGP LUT PSD/habit generation remains unverified. No production correction, source-unit conversion or observational validation.
